accounts.priya: Priya Natarajan, CM of Tides of Ash

notes: Captured from the help sandbox (~/owbn/_localwp-oat/help) after seed-cc-shots.php and seed-wpvp-shots.php: made-up people and votes. The plugin's screens are English-only, so the Portuguese pages reuse these images with Portuguese alt text.

alt.en: All Votes: Add New, the status, type and classification filters, Search Votes, and the votes with their Type, Status, Responses, Created By and Date.
alt.pt_BR: All Votes: Add New, os filtros de status, de tipo e de classificação, Search Votes e as votações com Type, Status, Responses, Created By e Date.

alt.en: Editing a vote: the title, Description, Proposal Metadata, Voting Type, Voting Options and the Status & Schedule box.
alt.pt_BR: Editando uma votação: o título, Description, Proposal Metadata, Voting Type, Voting Options e a caixa Status & Schedule.

alt.en: The Access Control box: Visibility set to Restricted, Load from template with Apply, and the Allowed Roles / Groups list with chronicle/*/cm and the coordinator patterns.
alt.pt_BR: A caixa Access Control: Visibility em Restricted, Load from template com Apply e a lista Allowed Roles / Groups com chronicle/*/cm e os padrões de coordenador.

alt.en: The Voting Dashboard: votes with their proposer, type, dates, ballot count, status and result, and a Vote button on the open one.
alt.pt_BR: O Voting Dashboard: votações com quem propôs, tipo, datas, número de votos, status e resultado, e um botão Vote na que está aberta.

alt.en: An open Approve / Deny / Abstain ballot with its dates, the live results, the comment box, the email confirmation option and Submit Vote.
alt.pt_BR: Uma cédula aberta de Approve / Deny / Abstain com as datas, os resultados ao vivo, a caixa de comentário, a opção de confirmação por email e Submit Vote.

alt.en: The result of a ranked election: the winner, Export CSV, the vote table and the Round-by-Round Results.
alt.pt_BR: O resultado de uma eleição ranqueada: quem venceu, Export CSV, a tabela de votos e o Round-by-Round Results.

alt.en: Voting Settings, General: Default Voting Type, Require Login to Vote, Show Results Before Close, Email Notifications and the recipient defaults.
alt.pt_BR: Voting Settings, General: Default Voting Type, Require Login to Vote, Show Results Before Close, Email Notifications e os destinatários padrão.

alt.en: Voting Settings, Permissions: the AccessSchema Connection with Test Connection, the WordPress capability fallback, and the defaults for new votes.
alt.pt_BR: Voting Settings, Permissions: a AccessSchema Connection com Test Connection, os recursos do WordPress de reserva e os padrões das votações novas.

alt.en: Role & Classification Templates: the Role Templates and Classifications tabs, Add New Role Template, and two templates with their roles.
alt.pt_BR: Role & Classification Templates: as abas Role Templates e Classifications, Add New Role Template e dois modelos com os cargos deles.
